Amar Dedic.note: Dedić's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Amar Dedic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Amar Memic.note: Memić's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Amar Memic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Amir Hadziahmetovic.note: Hadžiahmetović stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Arjan Malic.note: Malić stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Arjan Malic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Armin Gigovic.note: Watch Gigović for creating a better angle for the next pass. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Armin Gigovic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Benjamin Tahirovic.note: Tahirović's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Benjamin Tahirovic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Dennis Hadzikadunic.note: Hadžikadunić's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Dzenis Burnic.note: Burnić stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Dzenis Burnic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Edin Dzeko.note: Džeko's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Edin Dzeko.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ermedin Demirovic.note: Demirović is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Ermedin Demirovic.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Ermin Mahmic.note: Watch Mahmić for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Ermin Mahmic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Esmir Bajraktarevic.note: Bajraktarević's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Esmir Bajraktarevic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Haris Tabakovic.note: Tabaković is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Haris Tabakovic.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Ivan Basic.note: Bašić's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ivan Basic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ivan Sunjic.note: Šunjić is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Ivan Sunjic.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Jovo Lukic.note: Lukić is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Jovo Lukic.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Kerim Alajbegovic.note: Alajbegović stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Kerim Alajbegovic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Martin Zlomislic.note: Zlomislić's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Martin Zlomislic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mladen Jurkas.note: Jurkas's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mladen Jurkas.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Nihad Mujakic.note: Mujakić is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nihad Mujakic.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Nikola Katic.note: Katić stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nikola Katic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Nikola Vasilj.note: Watch Vasilj for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Nikola Vasilj.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Samed Bazdar.note: Watch Baždar for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Samed Bazdar.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sead Kolasinac.note: Kolašinac's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Sead Kolasinac.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Stjepan Radeljic.note: Watch Radeljić for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Stjepan Radeljic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Tarik Muharemovic.note: Muharemović's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Tarik Muharemovic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。
